name: fix_ts_foreach_async_never_awaits
description: Fixes a TS async total that uses forEach(async), returning before any awaited work completes
prompts: totalPrice in prices.ts should return the summed price of all skus (and 0 for an empty list). It iterates with skus.forEach(async (sku) => { total += await fetchPrice(sku); }), but forEach does not await async callbacks - totalPrice returns `total` while every callback is still pending, so the result is always 0. Fix the iteration so the prices are actually awaited and summed (a for...of loop with await, or Promise.all over the mapped prices) and make sure an EMPTY sku list still returns 0 rather than throwing. Keep the function signature and do not change fetchPrice.

test_setup_files.run_checks.sh:
set -e
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --noEmit prices.ts
tsc --strict --target es2020 --module commonjs --skipLibCheck --outDir build prices.ts
node behavior_test.js
